correctness.rationale: Condition on |A|=u>0 and rotate input and output. The map z^2-u zbar is proper of degree two and its critical circle has radius u/2. The critical value curve has nonzero radius and strictly monotone lifted argument (derivative vanishes only at the cusps), with one clockwise turn. This gives one bounded and one unbounded regular region; simple roots at zero and degree at infinity give four and two respectively. The Gaussian target avoids the caustic. The rotating phase preserves the conditional circular target law. Integrating the unit exponential |A|^2 gives the stated Laplace transform with strictly positive rate, which proves strict derivative signs. Changing argument to boundary parameter and integrating the Rayleigh variable gives the erfc expression. Expanding at small noise uses bounded reciprocal radii and finite Rayleigh moments; the first two angular moments give the stated elliptic expression and 2/3. At large noise the area and second area moment of the deltoid are 2 pi and 3 pi, and the exponential radial dilation moments give 1/4 and -9/32. The supplied checker.py was inspected, not run. The independent area-formula quadrature inside the negative-Jacobian disk in python /workspace/reproductions/reproduce.py gave p(1)=0.14635487513720 and independently reproduced the two large-noise coefficients.
